thesis_triggers.event: The 2027 build falls behind: nameplate compute below ~3.7 GW at Q1-27 or ~4.8 GW at Q2-27 (booked 4.012 / 5.354 needs ~1.2-1.5 GW a quarter), or a Rubin/HBM4 supply cut
thesis_triggers.check: Q4-26 and Q1-27 releases (Ex. 99.1 nameplate GW), Nvidia supply comments

thesis_triggers.event: External demand thins: a major lessee (Anthropic, Google) gives its 90-day notice, or Q1-27 revenue misses the low end of $33B by more than the build implies
thesis_triggers.check: 8-K / FWP filings on cloud services agreements; Q1-27 release

thesis_triggers.check: 8-K on the special committees; Tesla annual meeting 2026-12-03 (src 31)

supervisor_summary: Research target (12m) 100.22 after Kilian's 2026-11-19 card picks (100.93 after gate fix round 2, 100.80 after round 1, 108.54 before it; 107.29 before the New Street deck; was 119.42; 110.65 before the 2026-11-15 gate fix; 118.49 in the base round). Legs: 15x NTM EBITDA 149.33, SOTP 52.10, 27x P/E 98.25; downside (P10) 43.62, upside (P90) 165.98. YE27 compute 8.3 GW (Morgan Stanley post-Q3, Kilian 2026-11-16), 13.96 GW YE28. The fix sourced Starlink ARPU (Morgan Stanley path), utilization (0.90, Meta) and the Q4-26 external share (signed contracts in dollars incl. the CFO's $6.7B Q3-contracted cloud services, 0.479). Q4-26 capex $37.9B (guide $35-40B); Q1-27 revenue $26.4B, below the $33-37B guide at a 50% external share. FY2027 revenue $142.1B vs Zacks $165.0B. Kilian decided the six open cards on 2026-11-19: app revenue on Morgan Stanley's advertising + Cursor's latest pace ($10.8B / $15.3B), the Starlink deck's ARPU on the filed ~10% a year to 2031 and its mobile held at $1.3B a year (booked); utilization 0.90, Starlink ARPU on Morgan Stanley's path and subscribers +7.0M / +8.0M kept. The seven 2026-11-16 cards stay decided.
